provenance: Six cases and evidence IDs are adapted from adaptive-retrieval-v2. References were written from the indexed passages; they are compact, incomplete, and need independent review. Splits inherit the published source set and are not independent holdouts.

questions.question: How does the model associate financial holdings with a household group and with individual customers, and what can those holdings include?
questions.reference_answer: GroupFinancialHolding has Group and FinancialHolding links. CustomerFinancialHolding links a customer to a FinancialHolding. Financial holdings include accounts, loans, investments, credit lines and savings accounts.

questions.question: In the banking model, what can a cardholder refer to, and how does that relate to the customer linked to a financial holding?
questions.reference_answer: FICard.Cardholder can reference an Account or Contact. CustomerFinancialHolding.Customer can also reference an Account or Contact, and CustomerFinancialHolding.FinancialHolding references a FinancialHolding. These links do not by themselves establish that the two customers are the same record.

questions.question: How are customer holdings connected to account, loan and investment details, and what does each detail type represent?
questions.reference_answer: FinancialHolding.Details references FHAccount, FHLoan and FHInvestment among other types. FHAccount is a deposit account supporting deposits and withdrawals; FHLoan describes loans held by a customer with a financial institution; FHInvestment represents a portfolio of securities or other investible assets.

questions.question: How can a common Account refer to its primary Contact, and how can a Contact identify a parent customer?
questions.reference_answer: The applicationCommon Account.primaryContact relationship references Contact. Contact.parentCustomer can reference either Account or Contact.

questions.question: What do a common Account and Contact represent, and which CustomerRelationship field can reference either of them?
questions.reference_answer: An applicationCommon Account represents a customer or potential customer and the billed company. A Contact is a person with whom a business unit has a relationship. CustomerRelationship.partner can reference either Account or Contact.

questions.question: What schema identifies the holder of a card, and where are the roles a customer may have in a financial holding defined?
questions.reference_answer: FICard.Cardholder identifies the customer associated with the card and references Account or Contact. CustomerFinancialHolding.financialHoldingRole records the customer's role, such as owner or beneficiary. Its data-type trait records values including Owner, Cardholder, Signatory, Co-signer, Joint owner, Beneficiary and Guarantor.
